verdict_scope: EXACT SEALED J5 TICKET AND CURRENT CONSUMER/LAUNCHER PREFIRE CONTRACT ONLY; no formulation-family, contest-axis, score, or promotion verdict

review_targets.name: active_pair and lifecycle proposal mask
evidence: The opening mask selects tracks touching the sealed eight-pair set and checks the proposed axis shift against every knot in each selected track.
The exact winner realizes 18 center_x coordinates and is byte-identical to the measured V19 archive.
Lane is intentionally held only in stage 1 and becomes active in stages 2 and 3.

review_targets.name: Q8 acceptance and rollback through real uint8 R scorer
evidence: Q8 is deterministic optimizer-state staging; admission occurs only after integer receiver realization changes.
The candidate is compiled to an exact archive and replayed through receiver camera bytes, evaluator R, and frozen CPU SegNet/PoseNet.

Rejected candidates are separate immutable AdamStateV1 values; the admitted state is not assigned until acceptance. Exhausted shrink ladders persist and immediately parse back the prior admitted state.

review_targets.name: C1 role residual bucket reconciliation
evidence: The measured row reconciles exactly: role -1314 plus residual -2013 equals global -3327.
The scorer path fail-closes unless the five-class partition sums to the global count.

The fire-ready latch is nevertheless local to the last pure-price-admitted state. The code computes a cumulative delta versus baseline but does not use it to set warm_start_component_safe, so a locally safe second move can declare fire readiness while cumulative d_seg still regresses versus the sealed baseline.
review_targets.minimal_fix: Keep pure-price admission local, but derive the component/residual fire-ready latch from the candidate versus stage00 baseline using c1_bucket_delta_cumulative_vs_baseline; add a two-admission regression where the second move is locally safe but cumulative d_seg is above baseline.

review_targets.name: pose finish engagement
evidence: The sealed field pose_objective_engage_condition is only string-validated.

The launcher switches the exact sqrt-pose term from weight 0 to weight 1 immediately after any strict Seg admission; it has no #383 conditioning detector, engage telemetry, hysteresis, or run-owned pose-finish state.

The ticket uses the quarantined banked-R1 comparator d_pose 0.001610 as a binding stage target rather than comparator-only evidence. No banked bytes or weights are consumed, which is correct, but no measured same-vehicle path from d_pose 163.0613 to that target is bound.
review_targets.minimal_fix: Replace the declarative string/binary switch with a typed, checkpointed pose-finish engage state driven by the run's exact verdict history; preserve the exact sqrt-pose objective after engagement, emit engage/non-engage telemetry, and move 0.001610 to non-binding comparator metadata.

review_targets.name: real config memory and resumability
evidence: Atomic preserved checkpoints contain live theta, EMA, Adam moments, typed identity, run cursor, exact archive identity, and the canonical resume registry. Mid-stage resume is structurally present and the J5 checkpoint immediately parses back exactly.

The admitted memory row measured stage-1 pair447 geometry only. Static enumeration of the sealed lifecycle shows 8 island secants in that measured window, versus a worst stage-3 window with 28 island plus 24 Lane secants.

The realized-secant basis alone is DERIVED as 0.7276554108 GiB in the measured window and 4.7297601700 GiB at the stage-3 maximum. The 116-GiB ceiling likely has ample headroom, but the required worst-geometry full-config peak was not MEASURED.

The ticket still binds the older J3 preflight SHA and values; the fresh J5 runtime memory receipt has a different SHA. Runtime receipt admission checks typed config and target cache but does not close over final launcher/consumer source hashes.
review_targets.minimal_fix: Add a bounded stage-3 worst-window memory bootstrap at pair start 498 or 499 with all 52 secants active, bind its receipt and final source hashes into the ticket/admission check, and perform one J5-typed forced-process resume from its checkpoint.

review_targets.name: convergence stage exit and governed stop
evidence: The three d_seg values are preregistered fractional thresholds, not a measured trajectory or floor; one improving proposal does not validate them.
At maximum_steps, a stage advances even when the exact classifier says REALIZED_STAGE_DESCENT_CONTINUE and the target remains unmet.
The plateau predicate requires both components to be flat or worse, but the same exact row is first classified BLOCKED or REFUSE, so campaign_blocker prevents the documented plateau stage exit.
After three maximum-step advances the launcher reports FULL_RUN_SCHEDULE_COMPLETE without requiring the final d_seg/d_pose targets.
review_targets.minimal_fix: Make target-unmet stage limits and plateaus governed non-promoting stops, never successful stage transitions; require an exact final target verdict before FULL_RUN_SCHEDULE_COMPLETE and reseal the ticket with a measured or explicitly speculative trajectory/floor contract.
